author: logangraham
text: One of my most productive discovies in the past ~18 months is how lifechanging *deliberate audio curation* is. I've found certain (by conventional standards, odd) music shapes my thinking for 24 hours a day; kickstarts a vivid imagination; even influences my personal moral code.
